title: Le Velours Rouge!
course: Level 3, Extended Diploma in Art, Design and Communication
materials: Burgundy velvet, burgundy appliques, fringing, beads, feathers, feather boa, rigilene boning, eyelets, burgundy ribbon
body: This piece is a showgirl costume inspired by the Moulin Rouge. I wanted to express the liberation of women by creating a striking corset influenced by Catherine Zuber.
